summary: Defines general extensions for SDP and the Real Time Streaming Protocol to carry messages from a key management protocol, so media can be secured. It is presented as a framework that one or more key management protocols can use. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Before sending a secret video, both sides need to share a key. This adds a place in the call setup messages to carry the key-sharing messages.

questions: secure media key exchange in sdp
